protocol.disagreement: mean pairwise Spearman rho among 20 raw annotator score vectors aligned to HDF5 picks; lower mean rho means greater disagreement
protocol.evaluation: canonical_summary with DSNet change_points and 15% knapsack; F1 against only the held-out annotator user_summary; average over 20 users per video

methods.barycenter: 1D Wasserstein barycenter of the other 19 normalized raw annotation distributions
methods.mean: arithmetic mean of the other 19 normalized raw annotation distributions

protocol.tertile_assignment: sort ascending by mean pairwise rho, then video_id for ties; split into three near-equal groups using numpy.array_split
